description: Sequence of guidance anchored to interface elements.

howToUse: Use it to present a new screen or feature in three to five steps, each one pointing at a part of the interface.
Open it on the first visit and save in `onComplete` that the person has seen it. Let people close it at any step.
Point each step only at elements already on screen.
alternatives: Help that stays available: HelpMenu or HelpField.
A first-use flow that collects data: Questionnaire or WizardStepper.

keyboard.action: Moves through previous, next and close.

props.name: block
props.description: Use block for controls that take the full width.

examples.label: Multiple steps
examples.description: Three real anchors, forward/back, focus, Escape and completion.

examples.label: Action in the control
examples.description: Starts at the step whose action selects Image on the same Chip shown on screen.

examples.label: Closed
examples.description: Closed state; Restart tour opens and positions the first step.
